notes:
DntSpace v0.4.10

- Profile sync: opt-in multi-device sync keeps profiles and settings in sync across machines, with conflict-aware base merging, quota/stale-base error mapping, and per-item device-local exclusions.
- Session manager: new tools let you search, rename, and archive sessions from the agent loop; archived sessions surface in search results.
- Support reports: opt-in diagnostics can send support reports with crash breadcrumbs to help debug issues.
- Plugins: installs are now trust-gated and path-jailed; uninstalling one version no longer disables leftover plugin services.
- Loop badges: agent loop shows badges for child agents; provider model sync keeps models in sync with providers.
- Context dream: dream reconcile fails closed and slices source from the latest summary, with per-line marker screen and an enable toggle.
